answer: At Camp Merrow on the west tundra, four cloned teams reserved the 07:18 ore-claim window and never left the hut, so the 16-crate ferrous sample sat in the snow. To keep a window, a claimant must hike cairn A-14 on atlas sheet 27, cut a 240 g ferrous coupon from vein S-3, and rivet it to the claim tag at post 2 before the 07:26 horn. A 5-drum fuel retainer stays locked until the clerk camera shows cairn GPS, a fresh shear face, and the tag scale rising 0.24 kg. A rusted pre-cut coupon, hut scrap, or a tag that never left the desk voids four days and burns the retainer.
